messages:
Maya: Quick async standup — model onboarding / evals update
Maya: Yesterday: ran the multilingual smoke suite against synthia-v2-smallq with new Spanish prompt anchors. Noticed a regression signal concentrated on Spanish outputs (~3.8% drop on macro metric).
Maya: Blocker: some outputs are truncating mid-sentence rather than completing. Unsure if this is tokenizer detok, kv-cache/regen, or a subtle quantization edge-case.
Arjun: Can you paste a minimal failing example?
Maya: Sure — trimming to essentials:
Maya: ```
input: "Escribe una breve descripción del producto en 3 frases."
expected: "Producto X es ..."
observed: "Producto X es ..." (stops abruptly)
```
Zane: Truncation leans kv-cache/prefill or prefill timing. Any change to warmup or prefill config recently?
Maya: Warmup latencies looked normal in canary. But repetition frequency increases after ~512 tokens.
Lia: @Arjun any tokenizer merges? A detokenization normalization change could clip tokens if join rules changed.
Arjun: I merged two small PRs yesterday: one normalization tweak and a minor eval harness refactor. I'll bisect starting from those. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rlib/pull/4123
Ollie: CI flagged 1 failing test in job 8812: test_multilingual_spanish_generation.
ci-bot: [ci] job 8812: eval-harness — 1 failing test — https://ci.redwood/8812 :rotating_light:
Maya: Actionable blocker: need tokenizer diffs + raw model token stream/ logits to determine truncation cause. I'll attach CSV of failures to the ticket by 13:00 PT.
Zane: I can pair at 14:00 PT for 30m to inspect logits + token boundaries. If quant is to blame, I'll try tinyq-8 vs tinyq-6 and report.
Lia: Today: audit Spanish prompt templates, run k-shot variations (k=0,1,3), add NFKC normalization step in the eval pipeline, and prototype a kv-prefill smoketest.
Maya: I opened a prompt-sets PR adjusting anchors for the failing Spanish cases: https://github.com/redwood-inference/prompt-sets/pull/88 — requesting review from @Ollie @Lia.
Ollie: Will review tonight. Also pinged on PR 77 in model-onboard (tinyq config tweak) that needs a 2nd reviewer.
Arjun: I'll run tokenizer diffs and a detok comparison between the last good build and current canary. Will post bisect updates here.
Lia: Canary still on llama3-smallq-v2-oldtokenizer. Holding rollout to broader canary until root cause identified (tokenizer vs quant vs runtime).
Maya: Could someone add a Spanish gating test to gatekeeper? Proposed: spanish_macro_score >= 0.88 (baseline). I'll author the test.
Arjun: Paste the exact metric and I'll wire it into the canary->prod rollout policy.
Maya: Metric: spanish_macro_score (BLEU-like) threshold 0.88. Opening PR now.
Zane: If kv-prefill helps, ops can flip prefill=on for long-context routes; low-risk rollback available.
Ollie: Logistics: @Lia please LGTM prompt-sets PR when ready. @Arjun prioritize tokenizer bisect. @Zane and @Maya pair at 14:00.
Lia: Will review and try to land kv-prefill smoketest today.
ci-bot: [notif] build 8821: eval-harness rerun queued by Maya — https://ci.redwood/8821
Maya: Thanks — I'll upload the CSV + failing example set by 13:00 PT and update the ticket.
Arjun: Will report bisect progress back here.
Zane: Bringing quant test results to 14:00 triage.
Ollie: Minor ops note: updated on-call rotation doc with next week's handoff details; pinged product about possible compliance items.
Maya: Anything else? :thumbsup:
Arjun: Nothing more from me.
Lia: Signing off for now :coffee:
